records.tested_change: Fixed-budget visual-chunk ranking used ONLY prefill_q and prefill_text_visual_attention. Assignments were fixed BEFORE decode; decode_q was used ONLY to evaluate outputs, never to rank windows. Tested arms already included one-bit and two-bit mean logits, exact mean logits, exact softmax mass, embedding cosine, recency, position, interleaved and three seeded random controls. Relative L2 (candy/statue): one-bit 0.0251776756073 / 0.0222856578715; two-bit 0.0180378996159 / 0.0219474580539; exact mass 0.0151037603703 / 0.0151006670887. The exact-mass measurements are distinct, not identical. One-bit failed the frozen fidelity gate.
records.scope: Two already-exposed SmolVLM-256M still images; 30 layers and decoder steps 1–3. Eight chunks of eight visual tokens with fixed counts: two FP16, three INT4, three INT2; first chunk FP16. Generic affine KV quantization.
limitations: Not a WindowQuant or FIER replication; aligned-input embeddings and token chunks are proxies.
Not held-out data, video clips, end-to-end generation or propagated error evaluation.
Scoring uses 32-token key groups; resident KV uses 8-token groups. These are distinct surrogate operators.
No measured GPU memory traffic, speed or transient overhead; an efficiency-versus-fidelity tradeoff remains untested.
Exact softmax mass is a comparator, not a proven optimal precision allocator or fidelity ceiling. This result does not reject the whole source pair or establish general infeasibility.

records.tested_change: Already tested: per-query/per-head max of eight raw token logits per window, averaged over prefill text queries and heads, using one-bit, two-bit and exact keys. No decode query enters scoring. One-bit max relative L2 0.0249167856468 / 0.0211240995552 (candy/statue), versus one-bit mean 0.0251776756073 / 0.0222856578715 and exact softmax mass 0.0151037603703 / 0.0151006670887. All original baseline summaries reproduced exactly.
records.scope: 2026-11-17 posthoc exploratory follow-up on the same two exposed still-image traces and fixed resident precision counts. Not an independent or held-out test.
limitations: One-bit max slightly worsens cosine on candy despite lowering relative L2. No general fidelity dominance.
Still-image token chunks, generic quantizers and fixed native queries; not a paper-exact or end-to-end VLM evaluation.
No measured latency, memory traffic, transient workspace or production speed benefit.
Exact softmax mass is a comparator, not a proved optimum. No novelty or general infeasibility claim.
